
		<h2>

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">PocoEmit遥遥领先于AutoMapper之循环引用</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText"><div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一什么是循环引用">一、什么是循环引用</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>循环引用就是类型相互依赖</p>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-比如a类有b类的属性b类也有a类的属性">1. 比如A类有B类的属性,B类也有A类的属性</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这有什么问题呢?</li>
<li>编写生成A的代码需要遍历A的所有属性</li>
<li>构造B类型属性是A代码的一部分,B代码又含有A类型属性</li>
<li>这就是一个编译死循环</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-其他循环引用的例子">2. 其他循环引用的例子</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>链表结构只有一个类型也是类型循环引用</li>
<li>A-B-C-A等更长的引用链条也会构成类型循环引用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二举个树状结构的case">二、举个树状结构的Case</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>树状结构在实际应用中很常见</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-导航菜单代码">1. 导航菜单代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<p>导航菜单是一个典型的树状结构</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class Menu
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }
    public List&lt;Menu&gt; Children { get; set; }
    public static Menu GetMenu()
    {
        var programs = new Menu { Id = 2, Name = "Programs", Description = "程序" };
        var documents = new Menu { Id = 3, Name = "Documents", Description = "文档" };
        var settings = new Menu { Id = 4, Name = "Settings", Description = "设置" };
        var help = new Menu { Id = 5, Name = "Help", Description = "帮助" };
        var run = new Menu { Id = 6, Name = "Run", Description = "运行" };
        var shutdown = new Menu { Id = 7, Name = "Shut Down", Description = "关闭" };
        var start = new Menu { Id = 1, Name = "Start", Description = "开始", Children = [programs, documents, settings, help, run, shutdown] };
        return start;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-把menu转化为menudto">2. 把Menu转化为MenuDTO</h3>
<h4 id="21-pocoemit执行代码">2.1 PocoEmit执行代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>代码中多加了UseCollection</li>
<li>如果全局开启了集合就不需要这行代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var menu = Menu.GetMenu();
var mapper = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create()
    .UseCollection();
var dto = mapper.Convert&lt;Menu, MenuDTO&gt;(menu);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="22-执行效果如下">2.2 执行效果如下:</h4>

</blockquote>

</ul>

<h3 id="4-我们增加无循环引用再测试一下">4. 我们增加无循环引用再测试一下</h3>
<h4 id="41-无循环引用菜单">4.1 无循环引用菜单</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class Menu0
{
    public int ParentId { get; set; }
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public string Description { get; set; }

    public static List&lt;Menu0&gt; GetMenus()
    {
        var start = new Menu0 { Id = 1, Name = "Start", Description = "开始", ParentId = 0 };
        var programs = new Menu0 { Id = 2, Name = "Programs", Description = "程序", ParentId = 1 };
        var documents = new Menu0 { Id = 3, Name = "Documents", Description = "文档", ParentId = 1 };
        var settings = new Menu0 { Id = 4, Name = "Settings", Description = "设置", ParentId = 1 };
        var help = new Menu0 { Id = 5, Name = "Help", Description = "帮助", ParentId = 1 };
        var run = new Menu0 { Id = 6, Name = "Run", Description = "运行" , ParentId = 1 };
        var shutdown = new Menu0 { Id = 7, Name = "Shut Down", Description = "关闭", ParentId = 1 };
        return [start, programs, documents, settings, help, run, shutdown];
    }
}
</code></pre>

<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>Auto0是AutoMapper把Menu0列表转化为DTO的case</li>
<li>Poco0是Poco把Menu0列表转化为DTO的case</li>
<li>AutoMapper循环引用处理耗时和内存都是列表的3倍</li>
<li>Poco循环引用处理和列表性能差不多</li>
<li>当然就算是无循环引用的列表处理,AutoMapper耗时也几乎是Poco的两倍</li>
<li>这充分说明AutoMapper处理循环引用是有问题的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="5-先对比一下automapper有无循环引用的代码">5. 先对比一下AutoMapper有无循环引用的代码</h3>
<h4 id="51-automapper无循环引用的代码如下">5.1 AutoMapper无循环引用的代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">T __f&lt;T&gt;(System.Func&lt;T&gt; f) =&gt; f();
(Func&lt;List&lt;Menu0&gt;, List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt;, ResolutionContext, List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt;&gt;)((
    List&lt;Menu0&gt; source, 
    List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt; mapperDestination, 
    ResolutionContext context) =&gt; //List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt;
    (source == null) ? 
        new List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt;() : 
        __f(() =&gt; {
            try
            {
                List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt; collectionDestination = null;
                List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt; passedDestination = null;
                passedDestination = mapperDestination;
                collectionDestination = passedDestination ?? new List&lt;Menu0DTO&gt;();
                collectionDestination.Clear();
                List&lt;Menu0&gt;.Enumerator enumerator = default;
                Menu0 item = null;
                enumerator = source.GetEnumerator();
                try
                {
                    while (true)
                    {
                        if (enumerator.MoveNext())
                        {
                            item = enumerator.Current;
                            collectionDestination.Add(((Func&lt;Menu0, Menu0DTO, ResolutionContext, Menu0DTO&gt;)((
                                Menu0 source_1, 
                                Menu0DTO destination, 
                                ResolutionContext context) =&gt; //Menu0DTO
                                (source_1 == null) ? 
                                    (destination == null) ? (Menu0DTO)null : destination : 
                                    __f(() =&gt; {
                                        Menu0DTO typeMapDestination = null;
                                        typeMapDestination = destination ?? new Menu0DTO();
                                        try
                                        {
                                            typeMapDestination.ParentId = source_1.ParentId;
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                ex,
                                                default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                        }
                                        try
                                        {
                                            typeMapDestination.Id = source_1.Id;
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                ex,
                                                default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                        }
                                        try
                                        {
                                            typeMapDestination.Name = source_1.Name;
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                ex,
                                                default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                        }
                                        try
                                        {
                                            typeMapDestination.Description = source_1.Description;
                                        }
                                        catch (Exception ex)
                                        {
                                            throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                ex,
                                                default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                        }
                                        return typeMapDestination;
                                    })))
                            .Invoke(
                                item,
                                (Menu0DTO)null,
                                context));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            goto LoopBreak;
                        }
                    }
                    LoopBreak:;
                }
                finally
                {
                    enumerator.Dispose();
                }
                return collectionDestination;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw MapperConfiguration.GetMappingError(
                    ex,
                    default(MapRequest)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
            }
        }));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="52-automapper循环引用的代码如下">5.2 AutoMapper循环引用的代码如下</h4>
<h5 id="521-menu转menudto">5.2.1 Menu转MenuDTO</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">T __f&lt;T&gt;(System.Func&lt;T&gt; f) =&gt; f();
(Func&lt;Menu, MenuDTO, ResolutionContext, MenuDTO&gt;)((
    Menu source, 
    MenuDTO destination, 
    ResolutionContext context) =&gt; //MenuDTO
    (source == null) ? 
        (destination == null) ? (MenuDTO)null : destination : 
        __f(() =&gt; {
            MenuDTO typeMapDestination = null;
            ResolutionContext.CheckContext(ref context);
            return ((MenuDTO)context.GetDestination(
                source,
                typeof(MenuDTO))) ?? 
                __f(() =&gt; {
                    typeMapDestination = destination ?? new MenuDTO();
                    context.CacheDestination(
                        source,
                        typeof(MenuDTO),
                        typeMapDestination);
                    typeMapDestination;
                    try
                    {
                        typeMapDestination.Id = source.Id;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                            ex,
                            default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        typeMapDestination.Name = source.Name;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                            ex,
                            default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        typeMapDestination.Description = source.Description;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                            ex,
                            default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                    }
                    try
                    {
                        List&lt;Menu&gt; resolvedValue = null;
                        List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; mappedValue = null;
                        resolvedValue = source.Children;
                        mappedValue = (resolvedValue == null) ? 
                            new List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;() : 
                            context.MapInternal&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;(
                                resolvedValue,
                                (destination == null) ? (List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;)null : 
                                    typeMapDestination.Children,
                                (MemberMap)default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                        typeMapDestination.Children = mappedValue;
                    }
                    catch (Exception ex)
                    {
                        throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                            ex,
                            default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                    }
                    return typeMapDestination;
                });
        }));
</code></pre>
<h5 id="522-listmenu转listmenudto">5.2.2 List&lt;Menu&gt;转List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;</h5>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">T __f&lt;T&gt;(System.Func&lt;T&gt; f) =&gt; f();
(Func&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;, ResolutionContext, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;)((
    List&lt;Menu&gt; source,
    List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; mapperDestination,
    ResolutionContext context) =&gt; //List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;
    (source == null) ?
        new List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;() :
        __f(() =&gt; {
            try
            {
                List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; collectionDestination = null;
                List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; passedDestination = null;
                ResolutionContext.CheckContext(ref context);
                passedDestination = mapperDestination;
                collectionDestination = passedDestination ?? new List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;();
                collectionDestination.Clear();
                List&lt;Menu&gt;.Enumerator enumerator = default;
                Menu item = null;
                enumerator = source.GetEnumerator();
                try
                {
                    while (true)
                    {
                        if (enumerator.MoveNext())
                        {
                            item = enumerator.Current;
                            collectionDestination.Add(((Func&lt;Menu, MenuDTO, ResolutionContext, MenuDTO&gt;)((
                                Menu source_1,
                                MenuDTO destination,
                                ResolutionContext context) =&gt; //MenuDTO
                                (source_1 == null) ?
                                    (destination == null) ? (MenuDTO)null : destination :
                                    __f(() =&gt; {
                                        MenuDTO typeMapDestination = null;
                                        ResolutionContext.CheckContext(ref context);
                                        return ((MenuDTO)context.GetDestination(
                                            source_1,
                                            typeof(MenuDTO))) ??
                                            __f(() =&gt; {
                                                typeMapDestination = destination ?? new MenuDTO();
                                                context.CacheDestination(
                                                    source_1,
                                                    typeof(MenuDTO),
                                                    typeMapDestination);
                                                typeMapDestination;
                                                try
                                                {
                                                    typeMapDestination.Id = source_1.Id;
                                                }
                                                catch (Exception ex)
                                                {
                                                    throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                        ex,
                                                        default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                                }
                                                try
                                                {
                                                    typeMapDestination.Name = source_1.Name;
                                                }
                                                catch (Exception ex)
                                                {
                                                    throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                        ex,
                                                        default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                                }
                                                try
                                                {
                                                    typeMapDestination.Description = source_1.Description;
                                                }
                                                catch (Exception ex)
                                                {
                                                    throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                        ex,
                                                        default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                                }
                                                try
                                                {
                                                    List&lt;Menu&gt; resolvedValue = null;
                                                    List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; mappedValue = null;
                                                    resolvedValue = source_1.Children;
                                                    mappedValue = (resolvedValue == null) ?
                                                        new List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;() :
                                                        context.MapInternal&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;(
                                                            resolvedValue,
                                                            (destination == null) ? (List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;)null :
                                                                typeMapDestination.Children,
                                                            (MemberMap)default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                                    typeMapDestination.Children = mappedValue;
                                                }
                                                catch (Exception ex)
                                                {
                                                    throw TypeMapPlanBuilder.MemberMappingError(
                                                        ex,
                                                        default(PropertyMap)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
                                                }
                                                return typeMapDestination;
                                            });
                                    })))
                            .Invoke(
                                item,
                                (MenuDTO)null,
                                context));
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            goto LoopBreak;
                        }
                    }
                    LoopBreak:;
                }
                finally
                {
                    enumerator.Dispose();
                }
                return collectionDestination;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                throw MapperConfiguration.GetMappingError(
                    ex,
                    default(MapRequest)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/);
            }
        }));
</code></pre>
<h4 id="53-automapper有无循环引用的代码分析如下">5.3 AutoMapper有无循环引用的代码分析如下</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>循环引用的代码有2段,1段处理Menu,另1段处理List&lt;Menu&gt;</li>
<li>直接对比处理List&lt;Menu&gt;部分</li>
<li>很明显有循环引用部分多了不少特殊代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="531--automapper循环引用多出以下代码">5.3.1  AutoMapper循环引用多出以下代码</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ResolutionContext.CheckContext消耗内存</li>
<li>context.GetDestination消耗内存和cpu</li>
<li>context.CacheDestination消耗内存和cpu</li>
<li>context.MapInternal用于调用代码</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h5 id="532-automapper代码总结">5.3.2 AutoMapper代码总结</h5>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>MapInternal用于解决编译死循环的问题</li>
<li>GetDestination和CacheDestination用于解决执行死循环的问题</li>
<li>但是这个case没有对象重复引用,没有执行死循环</li>
<li>也就是说这里的GetDestination和CacheDestination只是消耗内存和cpu做无用功</li>
<li>更让人无法接受的是,做这些无用功的消耗居然是正常代码的好几倍</li>
<li>在无循环引用代码中ResolutionContext就是个摆设,无任何作用</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="6-执行死循环该怎么处理呢">6. 执行死循环该怎么处理呢</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>.net序列化给了我们答案</li>
<li>序列化默认不支持对象循环引用,需要特殊配置,这是为了照顾大部分情况下的性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="61-序列化对象循环引用代码">6.1 序列化对象循环引用代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">Node node9 = new() { Id = 9, Name = "node9" };
Node node8 = new() { Id = 8, Name = "node8", Next = node9 };
Node node7 = new() { Id = 7, Name = "node7", Next = node8 };
Node node6 = new() { Id = 6, Name = "node6", Next = node7 };
Node node5 = new() { Id = 5, Name = "node5", Next = node6 };
Node node4 = new() { Id = 4, Name = "node4", Next = node5 };
Node node3 = new() { Id = 3, Name = "node3", Next = node4 };
Node node2 = new() { Id = 2, Name = "node2", Next = node3 };
Node node1 = new() { Id = 1, Name = "node1", Next = node2 };
node9.Next = node1; // 形成环
var referenceJson = JsonSerializer.Serialize(dto, new JsonSerializerOptions{
   ReferenceHandler = ReferenceHandler.Preserve,
    WriteIndented = true
});
referenceJson.Display();
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如果以上代码不配置ReferenceHandler会报错</li>
<li>异常信息为A possible object cycle was detected...</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="7-poco循环引用处理的代码">7. Poco循环引用处理的代码</h3>
<h4 id="71-menu转dto代码如下">7.1 Menu转DTO代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">(Func&lt;Menu, MenuDTO&gt;)((Menu source) =&gt; //MenuDTO
{
    MenuDTO dest = null;
    if ((source != (Menu)null))
    {
        dest = new MenuDTO();
        List&lt;Menu&gt; Children = null;
        dest.Id = source.Id;
        dest.Name = source.Name;
        dest.Description = source.Description;
        Children = source.Children;
        if ((Children != null))
        {
            dest.Children = default(CompiledConverter&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/.Convert(Children);
        }
    }
    return dest;
});
</code></pre>
<h4 id="72-listmenu转dto代码如下">7.2 List&lt;Menu&gt;转DTO代码如下</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">(Func&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;)((List&lt;Menu&gt; source) =&gt; //List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;
{
    List&lt;MenuDTO&gt; dest = null;
    if ((source != (List&lt;Menu&gt;)null))
    {
        dest = new List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;(source.Count);
        int index = default;
        int len = default;
        index = 0;
        len = source.Count;
        while (true)
        {
            if ((index &lt; len))
            {
                Menu sourceItem = null;
                MenuDTO destItem = null;
                sourceItem = source[index];
                // { The block result will be assigned to `destItem`
                    MenuDTO dest_1 = null;
                    destItem = ((Func&lt;Menu, MenuDTO&gt;)((Menu source_1) =&gt; //MenuDTO
                    {
                        MenuDTO dest_2 = null;
                        if ((source_1 != (Menu)null))
                        {
                            dest_2 = new MenuDTO();
                            List&lt;Menu&gt; Children = null;
                            dest_2.Id = source_1.Id;
                            dest_2.Name = source_1.Name;
                            dest_2.Description = source_1.Description;
                            Children = source_1.Children;
                            if ((Children != null))
                            {
                                dest_2.Children = default(CompiledConverter&lt;List&lt;Menu&gt;, List&lt;MenuDTO&gt;&gt;)/*NOTE: Provide the non-default value for the Constant!*/.Convert(Children);
                            }
                        }
                        return dest_2;
                    }))
                    .Invoke(
                        sourceItem);
                    // } end of block assignment;
                dest.Add(destItem);
                index++;
            }
            else
            {
                goto forLabel;
            }
        }
        forLabel:;
    }
    return dest;
});
</code></pre>
<h3 id="8-automapper和poco生成代码对比">8. AutoMapper和Poco生成代码对比</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>AutoMapper生成代码量是Poco的3倍多</li>
<li>AutoMapper生成的代码可读性不好,Poco生成的代码几乎就是正常程序员手写代码</li>
<li>CompiledConverter.Convert对应AutoMapper的context.MapInternal</li>
<li>本case中Poco无多余缓存处理,节省了大量cpu和内存</li>
<li>如果有对象循环引用Poco该怎么办呢</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="三再举个环形链表的case">三、再举个环形链表的Case</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>链表是类型循环引用</li>
<li>环形链表又是对象循环引用</li>
<li>中国传统有九九归一的说法,以此为例</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-九九归一代码">1. 九九归一代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class Node
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public Node Next { get; set; }
    public static Node GetNode()
    {
        Node node9 = new() { Id = 9, Name = "node9" };
        Node node8 = new() { Id = 8, Name = "node8", Next = node9 };
        Node node7 = new() { Id = 7, Name = "node7", Next = node8 };
        Node node6 = new() { Id = 6, Name = "node6", Next = node7 };
        Node node5 = new() { Id = 5, Name = "node5", Next = node6 };
        Node node4 = new() { Id = 4, Name = "node4", Next = node5 };
        Node node3 = new() { Id = 3, Name = "node3", Next = node4 };
        Node node2 = new() { Id = 2, Name = "node2", Next = node3 };
        Node node1 = new() { Id = 1, Name = "node1", Next = node2 };
        node9.Next = node1; // 形成环
        return node1;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-pocoemit配置缓存解决对象循环引用问题">2. PocoEmit配置缓存解决对象循环引用问题</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ComplexCached.Circle表示只有检测到循环引用才开启缓存</li>
<li>ComplexCached.Circle策略基本等同AutoMapper</li>
<li>默认是ComplexCached.Never,不开启缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var node = Node.GetNode();
var manager = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create(new MapperOptions { Cached = ComplexCached.Circle });
var dto = manager.Convert&lt;Node, NodeDTO&gt;(node);
</code></pre>
<h4 id="21-执行效果如下">2.1 执行效果如下:</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>以下测试是使用vscode执行的(需要Jupyter Notebook插件)</li>
<li>测试代码地址为: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit/tree/main/Notes/node.dib" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit/tree/main/Notes/node.dib</a></li>

</ul>
</blockquote>

<h3 id="3-pocoemit还可以通过getcontextconvertfunc来控制对象缓存">3. PocoEmit还可以通过GetContextConvertFunc来控制对象缓存</h3>
<h4 id="31-getcontextconvertfunc调用代码">3.1 GetContextConvertFunc调用代码</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>GetContextConvertFunc是强制开启缓存,忽略mapper的缓存配置</li>
<li>并设置当前类型必须缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var node = Node.GetNode();
var manager = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create();
Func&lt;IConvertContext, Node, NodeDTO&gt; contextFunc = manager.GetContextConvertFunc&lt;Node, NodeDTO&gt;();
using var context = SingleContext&lt;Node, NodeDTO&gt;.Pool.Get();
var dto = _pocoContextFunc(context, _node);
</code></pre>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>需要特别强调,context是用来做缓存的,不是专门用来做处理循环引用的</li>
<li>巧的是缓存能解决对象循环引用问题</li>
<li>缓存除了处理对象循环引用当然还有其他用处</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>

<li>还可以通过实现IConvertContext来实现想要的逻辑和性能</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四重复引用非循环的case">四、重复引用非循环的Case</h2>
<h3 id="1-一个突击小组的代码">1. 一个突击小组的代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>小组只有3人</li>
<li>1人做队长</li>
<li>1人做通讯员</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">public class SoldierTeam
{
    public Soldier Leader { get; set; }
    public Soldier Courier { get; set; }
    public List&lt;Soldier&gt; Members { get; set; }
    public static SoldierTeam GetTeam()
    {
        var leader = new Soldier { Name = "张三" };
        var courier = new Soldier { Name = "李四" };
        var other = new Soldier { Name = "王二" };
        var team = new SoldierTeam
        {
            Leader = leader,
            Courier = courier,
            Members = new List&lt;Soldier&gt;
            {
                leader,
                courier,
                other
            }
        };
        return team;
    }
}
public class Soldier
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-poco默认情况下转化为5个对象">2. Poco默认情况下转化为5个对象</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>这明显并不是用户想要的结果</li>
<li>AutoMapper可以通过PreserveReferences配置跟踪引用(就是缓存)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var manager = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create()
    .UseCollection();
var team = SoldierTeam.GetTeam();
var dto = manager.Convert&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;(team);
// dtoList.Length == 5
var dtoList = dto.Members.Concat([dto.Leader, dto.Courier]).Distinct().ToArray();
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-poco配置缓存可以解决问题">3. Poco配置缓存可以解决问题</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ComplexCached.Always表示可能需要缓存就开启</li>
<li>实际是检测有类被属性多次引用就开启缓存</li>
<li>或有循环引用也开启缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-poco缓存转化代码">3.1 Poco缓存转化代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var manager = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create(new MapperOptions { Cached = ComplexCached.Always })
    .UseCollection();
var team = SoldierTeam.GetTeam();
var dto = manager.Convert&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;(team);
// dtoList.Length == 3
var dtoList = dto.Members.Concat([dto.Leader, dto.Courier]).Distinct().ToArray();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-poco生成以下代码">3.2 Poco生成以下代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">T __f&lt;T&gt;(System.Func&lt;T&gt; f) =&gt; f();
(Func&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;)((SoldierTeam source) =&gt; //SoldierTeamDTO
{
    SoldierTeamDTO dest = null;
    IConvertContext context = null;
    if ((source != (SoldierTeam)null))
    {
        context = ConvertContext.Create();
        if ((source != (SoldierTeam)null))
        {
            dest = new SoldierTeamDTO();
            context.SetCache&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;(
                source,
                dest);
            Soldier Leader = null;
            Soldier Courier = null;
            List&lt;Soldier&gt; Members = null;
            Leader = source.Leader;
            if ((Leader != null))
            {
                // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Leader`
                SoldierDTO dest_1 = null;
                dest.Leader = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                    Leader,
                    out dest_1) ? dest_1 : 
                    __f(() =&gt; {
                        SoldierDTO dest_2 = null;
                        if ((Leader != (Soldier)null))
                        {
                            dest_2 = new SoldierDTO();
                            context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                Leader,
                                dest_2);
                            dest_2.Name = Leader.Name;
                        }
                        return dest_2;
                    });
                // } end of block assignment;
            }
            Courier = source.Courier;
            if ((Courier != null))
            {
                // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Courier`
                SoldierDTO dest_3 = null;
                dest.Courier = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                    Courier,
                    out dest_3) ? dest_3 : 
                    __f(() =&gt; {
                        SoldierDTO dest_4 = null;
                        if ((Courier != (Soldier)null))
                        {
                            dest_4 = new SoldierDTO();
                            context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                Courier,
                                dest_4);
                            dest_4.Name = Courier.Name;
                        }
                        return dest_4;
                    });
                // } end of block assignment;
            }
            Members = source.Members;
            if ((Members != null))
            {
                // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Members`
                List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt; dest_5 = null;
                dest.Members = context.TryGetCache&lt;List&lt;Soldier&gt;, List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;&gt;(
                    Members,
                    out dest_5) ? dest_5 : 
                    __f(() =&gt; {
                        List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt; dest_6 = null;
                        if ((Members != (List&lt;Soldier&gt;)null))
                        {
                            dest_6 = new List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;(Members.Count);
                            context.SetCache&lt;List&lt;Soldier&gt;, List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;&gt;(
                                Members,
                                dest_6);
                            int index = default;
                            int len = default;
                            index = 0;
                            len = Members.Count;
                            while (true)
                            {
                                if ((index &lt; len))
                                {
                                    Soldier sourceItem = null;
                                    SoldierDTO destItem = null;
                                    sourceItem = Members[index];
                                    // { The block result will be assigned to `destItem`
                                        SoldierDTO dest_7 = null;
                                        destItem = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                            sourceItem,
                                            out dest_7) ? dest_7 : 
                                            __f(() =&gt; {
                                                SoldierDTO dest_8 = null;
                                                if ((sourceItem != (Soldier)null))
                                                {
                                                    dest_8 = new SoldierDTO();
                                                    context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                                        sourceItem,
                                                        dest_8);
                                                    dest_8.Name = sourceItem.Name;
                                                }
                                                return dest_8;
                                            });
                                        // } end of block assignment;
                                    dest_6.Add(destItem);
                                    index++;
                                }
                                else
                                {
                                    goto forLabel;
                                }
                            }
                            forLabel:;
                        }
                        return dest_6;
                    });
                // } end of block assignment;
            }
        }
        context.Dispose();
    }
    return dest;
});
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-poco通过getcontextconvertfunc也可以处理">4. Poco通过GetContextConvertFunc也可以处理</h3>
<h4 id="41-getcontextconvertfunc转化代码">4.1 GetContextConvertFunc转化代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var manager = PocoEmit.Mapper.Create()
    .UseCollection();
var team = SoldierTeam.GetTeam();
Func&lt;IConvertContext, SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt; func = manager.GetContextConvertFunc&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;();
using var context = SingleContext&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;.Pool.Get();
var dto = func(context, team);
// dtoList.Length == 3
var dtoList = dto.Members.Concat([dto.Leader, dto.Courier]).Distinct().ToArray();
</code></pre>
<h4 id="42-poco生成以下代码">4.2 Poco生成以下代码</h4>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">T __f&lt;T&gt;(System.Func&lt;T&gt; f) =&gt; f();
(Func&lt;IConvertContext, SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;)((
    IConvertContext context, 
    SoldierTeam source) =&gt; //SoldierTeamDTO
{
    SoldierTeamDTO dest = null;
    if ((source != (SoldierTeam)null))
    {
        dest = new SoldierTeamDTO();
        context.SetCache&lt;SoldierTeam, SoldierTeamDTO&gt;(
            source,
            dest);
        Soldier Leader = null;
        Soldier Courier = null;
        List&lt;Soldier&gt; Members = null;
        Leader = source.Leader;
        if ((Leader != null))
        {
            // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Leader`
            SoldierDTO dest_1 = null;
            dest.Leader = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                Leader,
                out dest_1) ? dest_1 : 
                __f(() =&gt; {
                    SoldierDTO dest_2 = null;
                    if ((Leader != (Soldier)null))
                    {
                        dest_2 = new SoldierDTO();
                        context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                            Leader,
                            dest_2);
                        dest_2.Name = Leader.Name;
                    }
                    return dest_2;
                });
            // } end of block assignment;
        }
        Courier = source.Courier;
        if ((Courier != null))
        {
            // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Courier`
            SoldierDTO dest_3 = null;
            dest.Courier = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                Courier,
                out dest_3) ? dest_3 : 
                __f(() =&gt; {
                    SoldierDTO dest_4 = null;
                    if ((Courier != (Soldier)null))
                    {
                        dest_4 = new SoldierDTO();
                        context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                            Courier,
                            dest_4);
                        dest_4.Name = Courier.Name;
                    }
                    return dest_4;
                });
            // } end of block assignment;
        }
        Members = source.Members;
        if ((Members != null))
        {
            // { The block result will be assigned to `dest.Members`
            List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt; dest_5 = null;
            dest.Members = context.TryGetCache&lt;List&lt;Soldier&gt;, List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;&gt;(
                Members,
                out dest_5) ? dest_5 : 
                __f(() =&gt; {
                    List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt; dest_6 = null;
                    if ((Members != (List&lt;Soldier&gt;)null))
                    {
                        dest_6 = new List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;(Members.Count);
                        context.SetCache&lt;List&lt;Soldier&gt;, List&lt;SoldierDTO&gt;&gt;(
                            Members,
                            dest_6);
                        int index = default;
                        int len = default;
                        index = 0;
                        len = Members.Count;
                        while (true)
                        {
                            if ((index &lt; len))
                            {
                                Soldier sourceItem = null;
                                SoldierDTO destItem = null;
                                sourceItem = Members[index];
                                // { The block result will be assigned to `destItem`
                                    SoldierDTO dest_7 = null;
                                    destItem = context.TryGetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                        sourceItem,
                                        out dest_7) ? dest_7 : 
                                        __f(() =&gt; {
                                            SoldierDTO dest_8 = null;
                                            if ((sourceItem != (Soldier)null))
                                            {
                                                dest_8 = new SoldierDTO();
                                                context.SetCache&lt;Soldier, SoldierDTO&gt;(
                                                    sourceItem,
                                                    dest_8);
                                                dest_8.Name = sourceItem.Name;
                                            }
                                            return dest_8;
                                        });
                                    // } end of block assignment;
                                dest_6.Add(destItem);
                                index++;
                            }
                            else
                            {
                                goto forLabel;
                            }
                        }
                        forLabel:;
                    }
                    return dest_6;
                });
            // } end of block assignment;
        }
    }
    return dest;
});
</code></pre>

<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>PocoFunc性能和PocoContextFunc性能差不多</li>
<li>如果喜欢隔离配置的同学,可以使用缓存配置方案</li>
<li>如果喜欢集中配置的同学,可以使用GetContextConvertFunc</li>
<li>AutoMapper耗时1.4倍,内存占用4倍多</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="五总结">五、总结</h2>
<h3 id="1-与automapper处理循环引用的原理是一样的">1. 与AutoMapper处理循环引用的原理是一样的</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>用其他对象调用,代替当时尚未编译的代码处理编译死循环</li>
<li>使用缓存解决执行死循环</li>
<li>缓存操作比原本对象转化耗时多太多,请大家慎用缓存</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-automapper处理粗犷一点">2. AutoMapper处理粗犷一点</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>所有对象转化都加上下文对象,哪怕完全用不上</li>
<li>检测到循环引用就加读写缓存,拖累到性能</li>
<li>用了AutoMapper如果感觉获取数据慢,可以查一下是否有循环引用</li>
<li>如果AutoMapper转化数据比实际数据库操作还慢也不要太过惊讶</li>
<li>这里链接园内大佬的一篇文章: <a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/dudu/p/5863042.html" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/dudu/p/5863042.html</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-poco处理就细致的多">3. Poco处理就细致的多</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>只有需要时才加上下文</li>
<li>上下文来自内存池,用完回收复用,节约内存</li>
<li>用户可以通过配置或GetContextConvertFunc选择性开启缓存</li>
<li>自定义IConvertContext可以提供更多想象的空间</li>
<li>另外无论是否开启缓存,Poco的性能都优于AutoMapper</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p>另外源码托管地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit</a> ，欢迎大家直接查看源码。<br>
gitee同步更新:<a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/MyEmit</a></p>
